title: What an update may overwrite, measured from the tool own bookkeeping
description: The template hashes file tracks 181 files: 74 under .trellis (scripts, runtime, agents, config.yaml, workflow.md), 52 under .claude, 46 under .agents, 8 under .codex, and AGENTS.md - and no spec file at all.
